name: SquidgeWorld Archive
summary: Non-commercial open-source OTW-Archive (AO3-engine) fiction & fanart library welcoming both transformative fanworks and original explicit prose.
ranking_rationale: Runs the beloved Archive of Our Own (AO3) tag, bookmark & EPUB-download engine (trade-off: much smaller total story count than AO3 itself).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
